purpose: Reviewable interaction and adaptive pedagogy specifications; no executable student UI or verified mastery

interaction.concrete: Build hundreds, tens, and ones with movable base-ten blocks; regroup 10 ones as one ten.
interaction.learner_action: Drag blocks into place-value columns and narrate each place's contribution.
interaction.symbolic_reveal: Reveal the expanded form only after the learner builds the number.
interaction.accessibility: Keyboard equivalent, spoken instructions, text-only alternative, and reduced-motion behavior required before implementation

adaptive_branches.diagnosis: Misplacing a digit in the wrong column

assessment.diagnostic: New seed and no answer reveal before attempt
assessment.transfer: Build a new number from different blocks without hints
assessment.mastery: Pending independent assessment rubric; never update student mastery from this draft

interaction.concrete: Overlay two fraction strips; subdivide both into a common unit without changing the whole.
interaction.learner_action: Select a common partition and drag the shaded pieces into one combined strip.
interaction.symbolic_reveal: Show the exact sum only after the learner identifies equivalent fractions.
interaction.accessibility: Keyboard equivalent, spoken instructions, text-only alternative, and reduced-motion behavior required before implementation
